text:
Mina K.: SI hit a hard stop on customer install. Cluster egress only via corporate proxy with no stable public IPs; helm deploy cannot pull images.
Devon H.: can you paste the installer error?
Mina K.: SI log: 
```
time=\"2026-03-21T08:12:40Z\" level=error msg=\"pull failed\" err=\"Get \\\"https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/\\\": proxyconnect tcp: dial tcp 10.99.8.7:3128: connect: network is unreachable\"
```
Akash R.: ok — three pragmatic routes: 1) customer imports our signed offline bundle into their mirror, 2) temporary egress whitelist for our registry CIDRs during install, 3) transient image-prefetch job run from a node with working egress.
Sophie L.: customer is FedRAMP-ish; whitelisting is unlikely. They requested a short non-tech checklist for their infra team and the signed manifest for audit.
Devon H.: we have signed bundles and a manifest with digests. Link: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/offline-bundles/marketplace/v2.3.1-signed.tar.gz
Akash R.: draft checklist to send SI: 
1) curl -O <bundle>.tar.gz and .sha256
2) sha256sum -c <bundle>.sha256
3) gpg --verify <bundle>.tar.gz.sig (pubkey fingerprint: 9A3F4B2DC1E877AA55EE3F98123456789ABCDEF0)
4) extract and `podman load -i <image>.tar` or `ctr -n k8s.io images import <image>.tar`
5) tag & push to local registry; update Helm values `global.localRegistry` and set `imagePullSecrets`
Devon H.: include a signed manifest.json for SOC with exact digests and the public key fingerprint. Also a sample values.yaml.
Mina K.: SI also asked for a fast fallback in case mirror import stalls — a transient prefetch Job. Can we supply both privileged and non-privileged variants?
Akash R.: yes. Non-privileged variant uses `podman` inside a job; privileged variant uses hostRuntime tools (crictl/ctr) and requires privileged securityContext. We'll label privileged as "advanced fallback" and require SOC approval + timebox.
deploy-bot: marketplace-install job failed for customer-beta (job id 4456) - see logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/marketplace/4456/logs
Sophie L.: action items: Akash -> assemble bundle + signed manifest + sample values.yaml; Devon -> prepare two prefetch manifests (non-priv & privileged) + SOC approval template; Mina -> send checklist to SI and coordinate timing.
Devon H.: will post PR with manifests and a short README for SI within 90 minutes. :thumbsup:
Akash R.: uploading signed manifest and bundle link to partner-runbook now.
Mina K.: thanks team. SI will attempt mirror import and will request fallback only if needed. Closing update in thread when SI reports back. :wave:
